summary: Enhance your skills with our comprehensive Microsoft Power Apps training. Learn to create custom apps and streamline your business processes effectively.
lede: Power Apps training prepares developers, business systems analysts, and IT architects to design, build, and maintain business applications. Learners practice modeling relational data in Dataverse, using Power Fx to manage app logic, and creating responsive Canvas and model-driven apps. The syllabus also covers workflow automation, external data integration, security and governance controls, and deployment management across environments.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level program is designed for professionals responsible for designing, building, and maintaining business solutions within the Microsoft ecosystem.
modules: Power Fx Logic and Data Manipulation
Responsive UI/UX Design for Enterprise Apps
Power Automate Integration and Logic Flows
External Data Integration and Custom Connectors
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of Microsoft 365 and experience building simple Canvas apps. Familiarity with Excel formulas and basic relational database concepts (tables, primary keys) is highly recommended. No prior traditional coding experience is required, though an analytical mindset is essential.
